items.quote: was Queen of Great Britain and Ireland as the wife of King George III
items.note: Rechecked after rewording. en:Charlotte,_North_Carolina: the city 'was named in honor of Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz, who had become the queen consort of Great Britain and Ireland in 1761'; this quote supplies the king. No longer gives the answer away, and George III was the reigning king at the town's 1768 incorporation, so there is one answer.

items.quote: It is the county seat of Mecklenburg County.
Charlotte is home to the Carolina Panthers of the National Football League (NFL)
the Charlotte Hornets of the National Basketball Association (NBA)
items.note: The team was the Charlotte Bobcats from 2004 to 2014; the current name is Hornets, so the answer is current.

items.quote: it officially opened on May 11, 2010, with the inaugural class inducted the day following the 2010 NASCAR Sprint All-Star Race
items.note: Rechecked after rewording; 'racing organization' now excludes 'stock car racing'. Pedant's footnote only: the same article says the City of Charlotte owns the building and the Charlotte Regional Visitors Authority operates it, so 'opened its Hall of Fame' is loose, but NASCAR 'committed to building a Hall of Fame' and it is NASCAR's hall. One defensible answer.

items.quote: Charlotte's central business district is referred to as "Uptown" by locals
items.note: The same article notes 'Downtown' and 'Center City' are also used; the word 'usually' in the question keeps Uptown the single answer, but a host may want to accept Center City.

items.quote: In 2004, Charlotte-based financial services company Bank of America purchased the naming rights under a 20-25-year agreement at $140 million.
items.note: Rechecked after rewording. The stadium clause now rules out Truist (also headquartered in Charlotte per en:Charlotte,_North_Carolina). The deal runs 20-25 years from 2004, so the name is current. Easy for anyone who knows the stadium's name, which is fine as a gimme.

items.quote: It is located in the North Charlotte neighborhood centered around North Davidson Street and 36th Street
items.note: The article gives the name as a portmanteau of 'North Davidson arts', i.e. still from the street.

items.quote: MLS awarded its expansion team to Charlotte in 2019, which began play as Charlotte FC in 2022
